trap.label: to e not to
trap.why: Em português 'para não falhar' vem com não; em inglês a negativa é not to + base.

fix.wrong: I wrote it to don't forget.
fix.right: I wrote it not to forget.

fix.wrong: He ran to no be late.
fix.right: He ran not to be late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I take notes. I don't forget.” com not to
rewrite.answer: I take notes not to forget.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I went. I buy a gift.”
rewrite.answer: I went to buy a gift.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “We left early. We aren't late.” com not to
rewrite.answer: We left early not to be late.
